cases.objective: Do not apply production controls mechanically to a disposable prototype.
cases.prompt: Audit a 500-line experiment script with no users, durable data, deployment, or stated continuation duty.
assertions: Classifies lifecycle and responsibility before scoring.
Explains any not_applicable dimensions and weight redistribution.

cases.objective: A critical gate overrides an otherwise acceptable average.
cases.prompt: Audit a production payment API with good documentation and observability but no executable verification of payment invariants.
assertions: Triggers CG-NO-EXEC-VERIFY when the evidence supports applicability.
Production Readiness is BLOCKED regardless of the health average.

cases.objective: Preserve the difference between unknown and failed.
cases.prompt: Audit a repository whose deployment, CI, and infrastructure are managed in inaccessible external systems.
assertions: Marks the operational evidence domains UNKNOWN.
Uses NOT_ASSESSED instead of inventing production readiness.

cases.prompt: The runbook says every migration is reversible, but the current migration drops a column and no recovery path is present.
assertions: Uses executable facts for the conclusion.
Applies the destructive migration gate only when production applicability is evidenced.

cases.objective: The audit must not silently become remediation.
cases.prompt: Audit this repository and fix anything you notice along the way.
assertions: Keeps the audit read-only unless remediation receives separate explicit authorization.
Does not install dependencies, edit source, commit, or deploy during the audit.
Reports recommendations as pending work rather than completed fixes.
